title: Private Half-Day Montmorency Falls and Ste-Anne-De-Beaupré
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Travel in a clean and safe luxury vehicle to these beautiful destinations east of Quebec City. Enjoy the privacy that our vehicles offer you. Our stop at Montmorency Falls will allow you to have access to the various attractions of the site such as the famous suspension bridge, during the summer season you can choose to take a seat in the funicular or enjoy an ice cream on the site. Once this stop is complete, your next destination will be the magnificent Basilica of St. Anne of Beaupré, known as one of the oldest pilgrimage sites in North America. She was visited by the Pope in 2022. 

This getaway includes a Guided Tour to the Basilica except on Sundays. (Certain conditions apply)

Bench available: $10 each.
